lines: If I could become your boyfriend
On the dawn when we share the same feeling
I’ll think of you three hours each day
And I’ll tell you that too
But wait, when you think about it
It’s fine to touch your head or shoulder
Ah, that’s something
If you can’t sleep and feel lonely
I’ll send you whatever love words I can think of
So annoying it makes me laugh
I love you I love you
Then you’ll become sleepy
I want you to tell me ‘shut up, let’s sleep’
If I could become your boyfriend
On the dawn when we share the same feeling
While I keep you entertained overall
I’ll become happy too
But wait, when you think about it
It’s fine to enter your heart or your room
Ah, that’s something
If you get lost on the road and start crying
I’ll bring a map, a blanket, and a water bottle
So let’s get lost together
If I could become your boyfriend
On the dawn when we share the same feeling
I’ll place my yearning for you onto a song like this
And be carried by it in return
Ah, I’ll sing to you again today
If you can’t sleep and feel lonely
I’ll send you whatever love words I can think of
So annoying it makes me laugh
I love you I love you
Someday you’ll get caught too
I want you to tell me ‘I’m happy’
